description:
Search awarded government contracts (U.S. federal from USAspending/FPDS, EU TED and national portals) by keyword in the award description, vendor (company name substring or 12-character SAM UEI) and/or NAICS code, with an optional minimum value and earliest award date. Returns award number, vendor, date, value and obligation in USD, agency and office, NAICS/PSC, set-aside, number of offers and description, newest first, plus a match count and total value. Use get_award for full detail.
FREE tier: 20 calls (shared with get_award) per visitor per 24h. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.

keyword.description: Words in the award description, e.g. 'body armor'.

name: search_awards
title: Search government contract awards
